title: Shows like Oz 9
description: Loud, ensemble-led comedy fiction for listeners who like their competence levels low and their disaster density high.
label: Maximum dysfunction

showReasons.eos-10: Another strong route for listeners who want full-cast sci-fi comedy with recurring character friction.
showReasons.wolf-359: A more emotionally expansive station comedy once you want bigger payoff under the jokes.
showReasons.station-151: Keeps the damaged-outpost weirdness while making the atmosphere colder.
showReasons.wooden-overcoats: Transfers the vanity, bickering, and comic collapse into a village-funerals setting.
showReasons.crystal-blue: A smaller quick-branch for more oddball sci-fi comedy energy.
showReasons.midnight-burger: A warmer, more idea-rich follow-up if the cosmic absurdity is the real draw.
